newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end lower despite NCD issue.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end lower despite NCD issue.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed slightly lower on Thursday, but the fall was limited by the central bank's issue of T$5 billion in NCDs on Wednesday to mop up excess money, brokers said.
The overnight interbank rate ended at 4.838 percent against Wednesday's 4.867 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 4.95-5.00 percent against 4.90-5.00.
Dealers said the central bank move showed its intention to prevent the interbank rate from lingering below five percent.
The bond market was quiet before the central bank's afternoon board meeting, which did not result in a change of monetary policy.
